notes: The ASV factors one *barren* out of the pair עָקָר / עֲקָרָה and writes the gender contrast as *male or female*; the shared adjective is placed with the adjacent עֲקָרָה and headed there, each morpheme thus holding the English written beside it. Giving *barren* to the first member instead was the competing reading.
Both waws take the disjunctive *or* the ASV wrote for them (rule 14's open list).
